name: thecodeman-ai-toolkit
description: AI for Developers Toolkit - Claude Code skills and agents for developers in any stack (.NET, Node/TypeScript, Python, Java/Kotlin, Go), plus a .NET pack. By TheCodeMan.net.

plugins.name: ai-dev-toolkit
plugins.description: 45 Claude Code skills and 7 specialist agents that run on your real code in any stack: ORM query optimization, API and architecture scaffolding, unit and integration tests, auth, caching, OpenTelemetry, logging, Docker and CI/CD, plus code review, architecture, security, database and observability audits.

plugins.name: dotnet-pack
plugins.description: .NET-only skills and agents: Span<T>/Memory<T> refactoring, packages.config to Central Package Management, classic ADO.NET auditing, safe WinForms maintenance - plus the Migration Pack (beta) for .NET Framework to .NET 10: an HTML assessment report with diagrams, effort with and without AI, parity tests, a YARP strangler setup and slice-by-slice migration of WebForms, MVC 5, Web API 2, WCF and EF6. Includes a runnable legacy sample app.
